user.title: Live Track Internet
user.description: Puts internet outages and submarine cables on the Live Track map. Cables: every submarine cable and landing point in Tristan Hotham's dataset of TeleGeography's cable data (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), shipped with Live Track Internet, each layer with its own box on the map, off until you tick it. Outages: Cloudflare Radar's outage records, one marker for each open outage, placed in the country or region it names, and any cable an outage names drawn in red. Outages need your own free Cloudflare API token. Make one at {token_url}: choose a Custom token and give it the permission Account > Radar > Read. Home Assistant asks Cloudflare for the outage list every 15 minutes with it. Leave the token empty to show the cables alone; you can add one later. Cloudflare Radar's data is licensed CC BY-NC 4.0; both sources are for non-commercial use. Please report mistakes in this dialog, and suggestions of what to add, at {issues_url}.

data_description.api_token: Optional: without it, the cables alone. Kept in Home Assistant and sent only to Cloudflare.

reauth_confirm.title: New Cloudflare API token
reauth_confirm.description: Cloudflare refused the API token, so the outage markers are off. Make a new one at {token_url} (a Custom token with Account > Radar > Read) and enter it here.

reconfigure.title: Change the Cloudflare API token
reconfigure.description: Enter a Cloudflare API token (a Custom token with Account > Radar > Read, made at {token_url}). Leave the field empty to keep the token you have now. To remove the token, delete Live Track Internet and add it again without one.

error.invalid_auth: Cloudflare refused this token. Check that it has Account > Radar > Read and has not expired.
error.cannot_connect: Cloudflare could not be reached. Try again in a few minutes.
error.unknown: Cloudflare gave an answer Live Track Internet did not expect. Try again, and report it if it repeats.

abort.already_configured: Live Track Internet is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Live Track Internet is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The new token works. The outage markers are back.
